semiconductor_relevance: High — Lasertec Korea Corporation specializes in inspection and measurement systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly in EUV lithography.
summary: Lasertec Korea Corporation provides advanced inspection and measurement equipment for the semiconductor industry, focusing on EUV mask inspection systems and wafer-related inspection solutions. Their products, such as the ACTIS A200HiT, are essential for quality assurance in semiconductor fabrication processes.

regional_presence.Korea: Lasertec Korea Corporation operates in Korea, focusing on providing inspection solutions for local semiconductor fabs.
